fields.description: Machine key used in code and as the autoname. Must match exactly what _compute_situation() references. Options: continuation, streak_protection, so_close, real_blocker, first_submission, grace_deadline, reinitiation, celebration.
fields.label: Nudge Type

fields.description: Evaluation order. Lower number = checked first. The first matching active nudge type wins. Change this to reorder without touching code.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: When unchecked, this nudge type is skipped entirely during situation computation.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: The value passed in data_block['situation'] to Vocallabs at call time. The Vocallabs agent prompt branches on this. Examples: returning_not_submitted, streak_at_risk, deadline_live.
fields.label: Situation Label
Description
fields.description: Admin reference: who gets this call, what it is trying to accomplish, and what the expected outcome is.

Fallback ParentCallConfig used when no LearningUnit-attached config is found for this nudge type. If set, the resolver tries (nudge_type + student language) here before falling back to VoiceAgentSettings.default_parent_call_config.
fields.label: Default Template Config

fields.description: N7 (Reinitiation) only. The keyword the student types on WhatsApp to restart a paused program. Confirm from Manu or from the Fencesitter flow JSON keyword trigger node.
fields.label: Reinitiation Keyword

fields.description: Guidance for whoever writes the Vocallabs agent prompt for this nudge type. What tone, what the specific ask is, common parent responses to handle.
fields.label: Call Script Notes

fields.description: When checked: student must have submission_count > 0. Ensures this nudge only fires for students who have submitted at least once before.
fields.label: Require Prior Submission

fields.description: When checked: weekly_submission_done must be 0. Student has not submitted this week yet.
fields.label: Require No Weekly Submission

fields.description: When checked: current_streak must be > 0. Student is on an active streak that is at risk.
fields.label: Require Active Streak

fields.description: When checked: program_status must be paused. Use for N7 (Reinitiation) only.
fields.label: Require Program Paused

fields.description: When checked: resolved_flow_state must be grace_waiting. Use for N6 (Grace Deadline) only.
fields.label: Require Grace Window

fields.description: Minimum program week. current_week must be >= this value. Set to 3 for N4 (Real Blocker) which targets week 3+ students with complex submissions.
fields.label: Minimum Week

fields.description: Minimum submission count. submission_count must be >= this value. Set to 1 for nudges targeting students who have submitted before.
fields.label: Minimum Submission Count

fields.description: Which escalation step types can trigger this nudge. Leave empty to match any escalation type. Add rows to restrict to specific types.
fields.label: Applicable Escalation Types

fields.description: Which current_expected_submission_types this nudge applies to. Leave empty to match any submission type. Used for N4 to restrict to complex submissions (image, summary_text_voice).
fields.label: Applicable Submission Types

fields.description: Per-language ParentCallConfig templates for this nudge type. At call time, the system looks up the student's language here first, then falls back to Default Template Config, then VoiceAgentSettings.default_parent_call_config.
fields.label: Language Templates

fields.description: Paste the relevant section of the Vocallabs agent_prompt for this nudge type here. This is documentation only — not functional. Keeps the Frappe config and Vocallabs dashboard in sync for auditing when prompts change.
fields.label: Vocallabs Agent Prompt Snippet (reference)
